title: A Treatise on Seeing Through
summary: A treatise on looking through illusion and disguise and false glow to the plain shape beneath and striking at that shape alone.

title: The Compendium of Absolute Clarity
summary: A compendium on spreading clear qi round the body as a living field in which no false thing can keep its shape.

title: The Twin Mirrors of Plain Sight
summary: A manual of two mirrors of clear qi that show the false and the true side by side so a foe cannot tell his own pretence from fact.

title: Treatise of the Hawk-Eyed Reckoning
summary: A treatise on a hawk's sight turned on a foe from above to count his wounds and lies and strike where he claims he is whole.

title: Manual of the Sworn Plain Word
summary: A manual of oaths spoken plainly with the whole qi behind each word so that a sworn word becomes a binding fact in the fight.

title: The Oath of the Unwalled Truth
summary: A sworn manual of truth held open on a clear bearing that offers no refuge to a lie and gives way only at the end.
